description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: new lib/zaq/engine/connect/credential_resolver.ex and resolved_credential.ex, Connect facade, test/zaq/engine/connect/credential_resolver_test.exs and property tests. Public internal boundary resolve_credential(credential_or_id, trusted_actor, opts) reloads persisted credential and uses ActorNormalizer.person_id/1; malformed actor carrying invalid Person identity fails closed rather than becoming org. This API is privileged runtime-only, not a Person-facing read/event action. Canonical lookup uses credential and owner only; no provider/resource fallback and no reads of credential.api_key/private_key as grant sources. After checking any supplied Person is currently present and eligible, disabled selects global. Missing/inactive/deleted Person fails BEFORE policy selection even when disabled, never global fallback; normalization is not authentication and stale aliases cannot silently reidentify ownership. Optional Person selects personal row if present, otherwise global. Required Person requires personal row irrespective of global availability. Non-Person selects global for every policy. Select ownership BEFORE checking status: revoked or expired personal row is not absence. Return safe structured reasons personal_credential_required, global_credential_missing, credential_revoked/expired/unavailable with credential_id as appropriate; no global availability in personal errors. ResolvedCredential contains safe dependency identity, auth_kind and redacted ephemeral authentication; generic auth data, never ReqLLM options. Only include consumer-needed secrets; never OAuth client_secret as an accidental runtime grant field. API/JWT usability checks status, timestamp and decryptability. OAuth may invoke existing refresh through the hardened boundary from step 7; until then return explicit expired error rather than fallback. Existing grant kind/config mismatch fails unavailable. Lock/read revision strategy must avoid returning known superseded material after mutation commits; document linearization and future consumer creation-race responsibility.

Tests to add before implementation: generated 2 Actor x 3 policy x 4 personal state x 4 global state = 96 cases (non-Person personal dimension deliberately ignored); assert selected IDs and exact errors. Property tests credential/person isolation, ignored personal state under disabled/non-Person, no fallback on selected grant failure, at most one grant. Test no runtime source from legacy secrets; corrupt ciphertext; wrong credential; stale credential struct; nil Actor privileged global resolution versus denied management; credentials deleted mid-resolution. Re-run OAuth expiration cases after step 7.

Branches/paths validated: missing configuration, incompatible material, all statuses, expires_at boundary with controlled clock, refreshable versus unrefreshable OAuth, non-Person required missing global. Resolution makes no LLM/provider authentication request and no per-request policy mechanism.

Mocking plan: real DB and internal modules; clock/config through existing injectable boundary Zaq.Config, no global mutation; mock external OAuth HTTP only. Documentations to update: API/types/moduledocs, docs/services/engine.md precedence/error table and runtime-only contract. >=95% touched-file coverage.

2026-09-14 FINAL USER-APPROVED STORAGE DECISION: canonical grants reuse owner_type/owner_id (org with NULL ID or person with non-null ID) and resource_type=connect_credential/resource_id=credential_id string. Native type/shape and explicit non-null/equality CHECKs plus existing credential_id FK; partial unique org/person slots across statuses. No binding_type, duplicate person_id, extra Person FK, triggers or guard rows. Server derives resource pair and configuration auth fields; secret_binding stays independent. Trusted canonical storage checks literal current active Person, without authenticating callers or resolving aliases. Concurrent orphan grants/secrets are an accepted residual risk. IDs must not be reused operationally; no silent reidentification through stale aliases; synchronous erasure is not guaranteed. Later resolver must check Person exists/eligible BEFORE policy selection even disabled, and missing/stale Person errors NEVER fall back globally. Authenticated writes and OAuth/refresh must recheck current identity; lifecycle cleanup/reconciliation and later distributed server invalidation remain unimplemented in storage task .1.

comments.text: Superseding storage decision: canonical queries identify resource_type=connect_credential and DB-enforced resource_id=credential_id::text, with Person identity in owner_type/owner_id. No binding_type or grant person_id. The canonical discriminator is not a fallback to legacy resource grants; existing precedence and all 96-case validation detail remain. Storage implementation awaits the isolation-integrity gate in zaq-jrg.1.

User explicitly approves implementing only .4 after completed-uncommitted .7, preserving .3/.5/.6/.7 and all dependencies with no closures/commits/push/worktree. bw start refuses because .7 remains intentionally in_progress. Proceed under this approval. Test-first scope: explicit 96-state matrix plus actor/identity, material/JWT/OAuth, concurrency, safe result/error and isolation properties; use existing prepare_grant_for_use only, final credential-first locked snapshot and raw config comparison, no consumer integration.

IMPLEMENTED-UNCOMMITTED; keep in_progress for review, no closure/commit/push/new worktree. Added Connect.CredentialResolver and runtime-only Inspect-redacted/non-JSON/non-Ecto ResolvedCredential plus Connect.resolve_credential/3 facade. Exact canonical owner/resource selection, fresh credential reload, ActorNormalizer canonical/flat compatibility with every non-null claim validated/agreed, literal current active Person checked before policy even disabled and after OAuth; no aliases or malformed-actor global fallback. NonPerson/nil intentionally org only in privileged runtime API; no public Engine action. Optional selects personal ROW in every status, required missing personal ignores all org state, disabled ignores personal only after identity. Selected failure never falls back; no legacy config key/private-key source. API key literal, OAuth access_token only, JWT RSA/EC PEM + issuer/key_id/subject/scopes/auth_profile_id; bearer/raw generic semantics, no ReqLLM/Agent/provider formatting. Account metadata whitelist selected account_id/account_name strings <=255 bytes, config secret projection omitted. Errors exactly credential_id + fixed reason: person_unavailable, personal_credential_required, global_credential_missing, credential_revoked/expired/unavailable/refresh_busy/refresh_failed. Engine/system-config/module docs record full contracts and final-read linearization; later consumer server-create/invalidation race remains outside scope.

FINAL VALIDATION: tests-first red confirmed missing resolve_credential/3; initial test syntax corrected before meaningful red. Added test/zaq/engine/connect/credential_resolver_{test, jwt_test, concurrency_test}.exs (actual names credential_resolver_test.exs, credential_resolver_jwt_test.exs, credential_resolver_concurrency_test.exs). mix coveralls.json test/zaq/engine/connect test/zaq/engine/connect_test.exs test/zaq/channels/jido_connect_bridge_test.exs test/zaq/channels/jido_connect_bridge_coverage_gaps_test.exs test/zaq_web/controllers/channels_controller_test.exs test/zaq_web/controllers/person_oauth_callback_test.exs test/zaq/node_router_sensitive_test.exs => 615 tests + 10 properties, 0 failures. Coverage .4 touched: CredentialResolver 99.2% (126/127), Connect 96.8% (212/219), Grant 100% (31/31), Mutations 99.3% (149/150), Refresh 97.6% (83/85). ResolvedCredential is struct/types/derived Inspect only: 0 relevant lines (N/A, not a behavioral coverage gap); construction/auth/redaction/JSON rejection tested. Final focused run of the three new files after test warning/alias cleanup => 162 tests + 3 properties, 0 failures. mix format; mix q (1215 files, no issues); git diff --check all pass. No backend blockers; existing nonblocking license_manager config warning remains. No E2E/full-repo suite: runtime backend only; focused compatibility suite above exercised prior slices. Small shared integration edits only: Grant.private_key?/1 consolidates existing mutation/resolver PEM validation; existing Refresh.fingerprint/1 is now documented internal and optional expected_fingerprint is checked by current/2 and claim before use, with Connect.prepare_grant_for_use forwarding opts. No new persisted revision/refresh path. Fifteen independent-connection race tests use external HTTP or real Repo telemetry commit barriers, covering replacement/revoke/remove/auth config/ciphertext/Person and disabled-global refresh identity deletion; raw unreadable cached ciphertext cannot hide as unchanged nil. No internal module/Repo mocks, no global config mutation. bw start initially refused intentionally-unclosed .7, then user-approved bw update set .4 in_progress; dependencies preserved.
